docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The 1,028 hymns of the Ṛgveda in the English verse translation of Ralph T. H. Griffith (second edition, 1896), book by book, with the notes he gave to many of them. The translation is of its time: its spellings and its readings are Griffith's, and later scholarship has revised many of them.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Ralph T. H. Griffith's translation (1896, in the public domain), as transcribed on English Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
